Tentacle of C'Thun
30% of base mana
Instant cast
Summon a Tentacle of the Old Gods near you for 30 sec.

It will seek an enemy out, dealing 65*$+ShaP*0.08+AP*0.03 Shadow Damage every 1.5 sec, scaling with spell power and attack power.

While above 60 Insanity, the mana cost of this spell is removed.

You may only have 1 Old God Tentacle active at a time.
